subject: Pre-QBR exception clearance: ownership, SLAs, and pricing ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-QBR exception pack and asks

Hi team,

Attaching the consolidated exceptions spreadsheet we promised to the execs (attached: exceptions_summary.xlsx). This thread is to: 1) confirm owners for each exception, 2) surface any outstanding procurement/legal blockers, and 3) align on final SLA language we will present at the October QBR.

High-level: Acme is asking for a small set of deviations from our standard Dedicated SLA for the pilot (latency p95 target, retention window, and audit log retention). We committed to providing an owner-level plan by next Wed (10/21).

Please:
- Review the Exceptions tab and mark owners in column H by EOD Mon (10/19).
- Karthik: can you estimate the impact on our latency SLO if we guarantee <120ms p95 for the pilot?
- Vivek: please confirm the fallback/canary policy and whether we can offer a temporary credit if we miss the SLA during rollout.
- Diego: can you confirm procurement path and whether Acme needs a separate SOW + PoP?

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cX-exceptions-preQBR
Attachment: exceptions_summary.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR exception pack and asks

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Quick owner roll-up and asks below (prioritizing the exec-facing items).

Owners & deadlines (firm):
- Latency SLA (p95 <120ms) — owner: Karthik Iyer — deliverable: microbenchmark numbers + quantization/instance sizing recommendation by Tue 10/20 COB.
- Retention window exception (short-term 45 days) — owner: Monica Patel — confirm compliance impact and retention proof points by Wed 10/21 10:00 PT.
- Audit log access & format — owner: Vivek Kulkarni — provide doc + sample schema and time-to-deliver for extended retention by Wed 10/21 12:00 PT.
- Procurement/SOW path — owner: Diego (me) — confirm legal redline and PoP; I've looped procurement@acme-analytics.com; I will push a draft SOW and DocuSign envelope by Wed 10/21 EOD.

Interdependencies and risks:
- If the latency remediation requires additional reserved GPU capacity, we will need a 2–4 week lead time from infra to resize Dedicated pools. That risk will be flagged in the QBR slides.
- Retention exceptions may need an SOC2 scope check; Monica, if this needs controls changes please escalate to Security ASAP.

Links: I uploaded the draft SOW + runbook to the shared folder (see thread link). Also opened a DocuSign envelope for signature (https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/1234-ACME-SOW).

CC: Sarah — we expect to share a short owner-level plan in the QBR; if the Acme team has any non-negotiables please call them out here so we can prioritize.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR exception pack and asks

Diego / Marissa — I'll own the latency SLA work. Quick notes:
- Initial estimate: with current model and instance mix, we can hit ~130ms p95 on the pilot berth. To get to <120ms we'll need either a) one larger instance class (NVIDIA A10x or equivalent) or b) tighter batching controls and model quantization.
- I'll run a targeted benchmark today and share the numbers + recommended instance sizing by EOD Tue 10/20.
- If additional GPU capacity is required, I estimate a 10–21 day infra lead time depending on region availability.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-QBR exception pack and asks — consolidated plan

Thanks all — consolidating final owner plan for the execs. See summary below and attached canary_fallback_plan.pdf (PDF, 180KB).

Consolidated plan (for slide deck):
- Latency: Karthik to deliver benchmark numbers by 10/20 (ETA met). If figures show >120ms p95, propose a one-week canary on the larger instance class plus auto-fallback to the previous configuration.
- Retention: Monica to confirm SOC2 implications; if negative, present a scoped 45-day exception with compensating controls (audit logs + read-only exports).
- Audit logs: Deliver schema + sample extracts; propose 90-day export window while retention exception is active.
- Credits: propose a capped credit for first 30 days post-launch if p95 exceeds SLA (proposal: 10% of monthly committed spend, capped).
- Procurement: Diego to publish the SOW + DocuSign envelope by EOD 10/21.

Next steps:
- Marissa: please prep a one-slide summary for the QBR with the owner table (owners, mitigations, risk level).
- Diego: please confirm final SOW link when it's ready so I can include it in the slide notes.
- Karthik/Monica: hit the deliverables above by 10/21 12:00 PT.

Attachment: canary_fallback_plan.pdf

I'll mark this thread as ready for exec review after we have the SOW link and Monica's SOC2 note.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform & Reliability | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
